prompts.prompt:
Use case: compositing / identity-preserve.
Asset type: production Unity 2D sprite atlas, twelve COMPLETE girl-with-boat sprites, transparent alpha.
Input image 1 is the character identity, rendering style, outfit and fishing-pose reference. Input image 2 is the boat, hat and palette reference. Redraw the complete subjects together; do not paste disconnected accessories.
Primary request: create a clean uniform FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS sprite sheet. Each of the twelve cells contains ONE fully integrated illustration of the same young brown-haired girl SEATED INSIDE one boat, actually wearing her selected headwear. Every sprite includes the ENTIRE boat, girl, both hands holding the rod/reel, and entire fishing rod pointing upper-left.
Character in EVERY CELL: short rounded brown BOB haircut, friendly face looking left, blue-white striped sleeves and orange life vest, charcoal trousers. Match the provided cartoon style and identity. Use a natural seated fishing pose, torso angled toward left, elbows bent, fingers grasp the fishing rod and reel. Hips rest on a bench, legs/feet INSIDE boat and hidden naturally by the hull; near boat gunwale overlaps lower torso. Head about one-quarter the boat's width, not a tiny person.
COLUMN 1: no hat, unobstructed bob hair.
COLUMN 2: white and cyan visor genuinely WORN around forehead, brim projects LEFT, head enters visor band; upper hair should overlap naturally, no gap.
COLUMN 3: yellow bucket hat genuinely WORN, crown encloses the upper head, hat band overlaps hair above eyebrows, brim wraps around head. It MUST NOT balance on top of full hair or float above scalp.
COLUMN 4: red bandana with small white fish pattern genuinely TIED around head, fabric replaces/occludes upper hair, knot at back/right, fitted to forehead, no gap.
ROW 1: warm varnished wooden rowboat with small fishing net at left, bow at right.
ROW 2: white rowboat with red stripe, wooden bench visible, bow at right.
ROW 3: white-red small motorboat, dark outboard motor at left, little cyan windshield at right, girl sitting naturally on the actual interior seat behind the near gunwale.
Integration: draw hat-head contacts, occlusion, contact shadows, shoulder/arm anatomy and bench seating as ONE coherent illustration. Do NOT show empty boats or isolated hats anywhere.
Grid: twelve separated equal cells, centered subjects, identical approximate boat width and waterline in all cells; at least 7% clear padding within each cell. Every rod tip, boat end and hat completely inside its own cell. NO neighboring fragments or overlaps. Transparent empty background, no lake, no water splashes, no ground shadows, no text, no labels, no UI, no checkerboard drawn. High-resolution 2048x1536 landscape atlas, smooth crisp dark outlines, polished colorful casual fishing-game illustration.
